messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف معلومات غير موجودة، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON فقط وفق الشكل: {"book_code":"TADAM","verses":[{"chapter":1,"verse":1,"text_ar":"..."}]}. أخرج وحدة واحدة لكل مدخل بالترتيب. إذا كان مرجع المصدر مجمّعاً مثل 1,2 فترجم نصه مرة واحدة واجعل verse أول رقم فقط، ولا تقسّمه إلى وحدتين.

{"book_code":"TADAM","units":[{"chapter":34,"source_ref":"34:2","text":"separate limb. These hath God appointed for chastisement. All these things hath the Lord sent to me and to all our race.'"},{"chapter":35,"source_ref":"35:1","text":"Thus spake Adam to his sons, and he was seized with violent pains, and he cried out with a loud voice, 'What shall I do I am in distress. So cruel are the pains with which I am beset.' And when Eve had seen him weeping, she also began to weep herself, and said: 'O Lord my God, hand over to me his pain, for it is I who sinned.'"},{"chapter":35,"source_ref":"35:3","text":"And Eve said to Adam: 'My lord, give me a part of thy pains, for this hath come to thee from fault of mine.'"},{"chapter":36,"source_ref":"36:1","text":"And Adam said to Eve: 'Rise up and go with my son Seth to the neighbourhood of paradise, and put dust on your heads and throw yourselves on the ground and lament in the sight of"},{"chapter":36,"source_ref":"36:2","text":"God. Perchance He will have pity (upon you) and send His angel across to the tree of His mercy, whence floweth the oil of life, and will give you a drop of it, to anoint me with it, that I may have rest from these pains, by which I am being consumed.'"}]}

response_format: JSON schema with book_code and verses. Each item has integer chapter, integer verse, and Arabic text_ar. Return one item per input unit, in input order, using the first printed number when a source label is grouped: 34:2, 35:1, 35:3, 36:1, 36:2.
